note: Gallatin County KY has zoning per the state map, and its planning office publishes an interactive zoning viewer, but no queryable public ArcGIS REST or file download of zoning districts was found after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online, the county site, LINK-GIS, KyGovMaps, and commercial parcel sellers (Dynamo, Regrid, Acres) which are paid or not services. The county's zoning viewer is not a public service we could read.
